verdict.rationale: FreeAgent documents a public OAuth-secured API with endpoints such as invoices and bank transactions. Nothing in the evidence shows a general ledger, trial balance, or accounting-report endpoint, or export in open formats. Bank-transaction and invoice endpoints are adjacent data, not the ledger or trial balance the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
